message: Hardcoded production API secret key detected in deployment manifest
recommendation: Migrate the hardcoded secret to a secure secrets manager (e.g., Vault or AWS Secrets Manager) and inject via environment variables.

message: Weak mock token or insecure testing credential found in test suite
recommendation: Ensure test mock credentials are restricted exclusively to test mock servers and not reused in live staging or production.

message: Unencrypted communication protocol configured without environment indicators
recommendation: Enforce TLS 1.3 across all communication endpoints and explicitly define the target environment context.
